padding_hazard.status: RESOLVED FROM CODE AND FROM MEASUREMENT. This was the one genuinely open AMS item after iteration 4; it is now closed in both directions.
mechanism: extractor.py:167-173 tokenizes with padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=512 and NO padding_side argument.
extractor.py:130 reads hidden_states[:, -1, :] -- the LAST position of the padded batch.

grep 'padding_side' over every .py in AMS src returns ZERO matches (positive control: 'padding=True' returns 1 match in the same files in the same session), so the tokenizer's own padding_side governs.

transformers PreTrainedTokenizerBase declares the class attribute padding_side: str = "right" (raw.githubusercontent.com/huggingface/transformers/main/src/transformers/tokenization_utils_base.py), overridden only by a padding_side key in tokenizer_config.json.
CONSEQUENCE: with right padding and a last-position hook, every prompt SHORTER than the batch maximum is read at a PAD position. This is a bug in the released tool, not in our reimplementation.

padding_hazard.OPERATIONAL_INSTRUCTION_FOR_THE_EXPERIME: AMS sigma must be reported at batch 1 AND at the released default batch 8. THE BATCH-1 NUMBER IS THE BAR. Any difference between the two is a padding artefact, not a property of the checkpoint: with right padding and a last-position hook every prompt shorter than the batch maximum is read at a PAD position, which is a bug in the released tool and not in our reimplementation. The measured magnitude reaches 5.283 sigma on tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct (6.460 -> 1.177 on harmful_content), enough to flip the tool's own verdict from PASS to CRITICAL, and 0.819 sigma on Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B (PASS -> WARNING), while unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, whose tokenizer sets padding_side='left', shifts by 1.4e-06. All four Qwen3-4B panel repos leave padding_side ABSENT and therefore inherit the HF default 'right', so all four are exposed. The batch-8 number is FOOTNOTED, never used.
